_about: Troop voices for the army's shouts (tools/army/voice_shouts.py). Heroes use tools/voice/cast.json.

gale.why: Loud warrior-princess voice with emotional depth: wild Galeborn riders shouting over the wind.

line.why: Gruff, high-energy middle-aged British character voice made for games: the infantry sergeant.

order.why: Warm, steady British woman's voice: a cleric who stays calm under fire.

stone.voice: Dennis Garber - Slow, Deep and Gravely
stone.why: Slow, deep, gruff and gravelly: Stoneborn shieldbreakers (distinct from Gorrim, Gorrath and Orrok).

veil.why: Deep, dark and calm, deliberate delivery: cold, quiet Veilwalker hunters.

wall.why: Powerful, commanding female voice with battle-hardened grit: the hard, loud crossbow line.
